source: UN News, Al Jazeera, DW, BBC, CBC

slides.headline: Why did the world’s climate talks just collapse?
slides.subline: **COP31 in Antalya ended without a deal.** Here is what went wrong.

slides.body: The UN climate summit in **Antalya, Türkiye** ran two days over, then closed on **Nov. 22** with [[no overall agreement]]. CBC says it is the first time since 2009.
Countries rejected the draft text. The EU and others said it did not deal with how to move away from [[fossil fuels]] or how to fund climate action in poorer countries.
It was not a total blank. UN Climate Change chief Simon Stiell pointed to a deal on a [[just transition]] and a set of **Action Agenda** initiatives.
Secretary-General António Guterres said he was **deeply disappointed**, but stressed there is [[no ambiguity in the science]]: fossil fuels remain the main driver of warming.
Without a shared text, **no new global promise** was made on fossil fuels or money this year. Should climate talks stay in the UN, or find a new format? Tell us below.
